records.task: Follow the left common carotid exterior in the long-axis CT view. The worked case supplies its grayscale and duplex acquisition.

scoreEvidence.fidelity: At the saved left crop the whole-surface maximum is 0.77 mm. The protected cuts agree within 0.74 mm, including the long-axis section and the terminal crop rims.
scoreEvidence.form: The section changes from near-round to longitudinal without a new pinch. The reverse clay view shows smoother highlight flow along the straight segment. The source retains an irregular lower bend in the full extent.
scoreEvidence.readability: The long-axis strip sits lateral to the thyroid. Rotating from the oblique view and matching the grayscale strip to the overlay makes this small structure easier to follow.
scoreEvidence.economy: The neck port falls from 1,984 to 1,650 triangles. Its worst turning-silhouette change is 0.50 px at 3 px/mm.

records.disposition: Adopt for the named 3D orientation task
records.note: The exterior supports side-specific course and orientation. Duplex signals, plaque, luminal patency and wall measurements require separate evidence.

records.task: Locate the left common carotid beside the thyroid in the transverse neck scene.

scoreEvidence.fidelity: The full traced course and its scan-limited superior rim pass the raw-label and protected-section checks on the s1127 grid.
scoreEvidence.form: The curved lower extent is preserved. The broad highlight follows the trunk in neutral clay and the reverse view.
scoreEvidence.readability: The vessel flanks the gland laterally. The axial orbit separates it from the thyroid and the trachea.
scoreEvidence.economy: The complete registered exterior uses 1,900 triangles and 34,232 bytes. Its 24 turning silhouettes stay within 1 px of the dense field.

records.disposition: Adopt for the named 3D context use
